scenarios.title: Input/output phase
steps: Open the Gain tab in the official editor.
Set InA from Normal to Inverse, then click Action done.
Set InA back from Inverse to Normal, then click Action done.
Set Out1 from Normal to Inverse, then click Action done.
Set Out1 back from Inverse to Normal, then click Action done.

scenarios.title: Matrix attenuation
steps: Open the Matrix tab.
Set Out1/InA matrix gain to +0.0 dB, then click Action done.
Set Out1/InA matrix gain to -6.0 dB, then click Action done.
Set Out1/InA matrix gain to -20.0 dB, then click Action done.
Set Out1/InA matrix gain to -60.0 dB, then click Action done.

scenarios.title: Gate InA
steps: Open the Gate tab.
On InA, set Threshold to -40.0 dB, then click Action done.
On InA, set Attack to 10 ms, then click Action done.
On InA, set Hold to 250 ms, then click Action done.
On InA, set Release to 750 ms, then click Action done.

scenarios.title: Compressor Out1
steps: Open the Comp tab.
On Out1, set Threshold to -20.0 dB, then click Action done.
On Out1, set Ratio to 1:4.0, then click Action done.
On Out1, set Knee to 6 dB, then click Action done.
On Out1, set Attack to 25 ms, then click Action done.
On Out1, set Release to 800 ms, then click Action done.

scenarios.title: Limiter Out1
steps: Open the Limit tab.
On Out1, set Threshold to -10.0 dB, then click Action done.
On Out1, set Attack to 20 ms, then click Action done.
On Out1, set Release to 500 ms, then click Action done.

scenarios.title: Input/output delay
steps: Open the Delay tab.
In ms unit, set InA to 1.000 ms, then click Action done.
In ms unit, set Out1 to 10.000 ms, then click Action done.
Switch unit to m, then click Action done.
Switch unit to ft, then click Action done.

scenarios.title: PEQ + HPF/LPF
steps: Open the InA tab.
Band 1: set Gain to +3.0 dB, then click Action done.
Band 1: change Type to Low Shelf, then click Action done.
Band 1: enable Bypass, then click Action done.
HighPass: set 315.0 Hz and BW -24 slope, then click Action done.
LowPass: set 20.16 kHz and LK/LR -48 slope, then click Action done.
Open the Out1 tab.
Band 9: set Gain to -3.0 dB, then click Action done.

scenarios.title: GEQ bypass/reset
steps: Open the GEQ tab.
On InA, set 1 kHz to +3.0 dB, then click Action done.
Click EQ Bypass, then click Action done.
Click EQ Reset, confirm OK, then click Action done.

scenarios.title: Test Tone
steps: Open Test Tone.
Select Analog Input, then click Action done.
Select Pink Noise, then click Action done.
Select White Noise, then click Action done.
Select Sine Wave 20 Hz, then click Action done.
Select Sine Wave 1 kHz, then click Action done.
Select Sine Wave 20 kHz, then click Action done.

scenarios.title: Channel Name
steps: Open Channel Name.
Rename InA to 12345678, click Set, then click Action done.
Rename Out1 to 12345678, click Set, then click Action done.
Restore InA and Out1 to their original names, then click Action done.

scenarios.title: Link and Copy
steps: Open Link.
Link InA with InB, click Set, then click Action done.
Change one simple parameter on InA to verify it applies to InB, then click Action done.
Open Copy.
Copy InA to InB, then click Action done.
Copy Out1 to Out2, then click Action done.

scenarios.title: File / Setting ID-IP / Lock
steps: Open File and click Open without selecting a file, then click Action done.
Open File and note the visible options, then click Action done.
Open Setting ID/IP without changing values, then click Action done.
Open Lock without validating a change, then click Action done.
